name: CE_RECON_TOLERANCE_RULES_
description: CE_RECON_TOLERANCE_RULES contains tolerance rule definitions. Tolerance rules are used during reconciliation.

columns.name: RECON_TOLERANCE_RULE_ID
columns.description: System generated primary key identifier for the tolerance rule.

columns.name: TOLERANCE_RULE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the reconciliation tolerance rule.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of the reconciliation tolerance rule.

columns.name: DAYS_BEFORE
columns.description: Date tolerance.  Number of days before.

columns.name: DAYS_AFTER
columns.description: Date tolerance.  Number of days after.

columns.name: AMOUNT_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether this rule is enabled for amount tolerance.

columns.name: PERCENT_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether this rule is enabled for percent tolerance.

columns.name: DATE_ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether this rule is enabled for date tolerance.

columns.name: AMOUNT_BELOW
columns.description: Amount tolerance.  Amount below the statement line amount.

columns.name: AMOUNT_ABOVE
columns.description: Amount tolerance.  Amount above the statement line amount.

columns.name: PERCENT_BELOW
columns.description: Percent tolerance.  Percentage below the statement line amount.

columns.name: PERCENT_ABOVE
columns.description: Percent tolerance.  Percentage above the statement line amount.

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether this is an active rule.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.

columns.name: AUDIT_IMPERSONATOR_
columns.description: Original Impersonator User.
